normal_air.name: Normal air: 14.7 psia, 21%
normal_air.note: Sea-level pressure with normal oxygen. One of the NASA-considered atmospheres listed in PSI-20.
normal_air.source: PSI-20 (ACME BRE) objectives: "NASA - considered atmosphere for human space missions will be examined: 14.7 psia, 21 % oxygen"

exploration_10_2.name: NASA exploration: 10.2 psia, 26.5%
exploration_10_2.note: Lower pressure with more oxygen. Listed in PSI-20 as an atmosphere considered for human space missions.

exploration_8_2.name: NASA exploration: 8.2 psia, 34%
exploration_8_2.note: The lowest-pressure, highest-oxygen atmosphere listed in PSI-20. It falls inside the Moon-base zone.

moon_base_limit.name: Moon-base limit: 10.2 psi, 30%
moon_base_limit.note: The corner of the expected Moon-base range: 30% oxygen or more, 10.2 psi or less. Real Moon-base air could be anywhere inside that zone.
